command: WGPU_BACKEND=vulkan X3_REQUIRE_GPU=1 cargo test -p x3-accel-wgpu --lib every_hardware_adapter_matches_cpu_hashes -- --nocapture

result.comparison: Every adapter hash output was compared byte-for-byte with the repository CPU reference over empty, short, rate-boundary, and 1 KiB inputs. ECDSA verdicts came from a real signature and the same signature over a different digest; both adapters returned [true, false] exactly.

limitations: This proves hardware parity for SHA-256 and Keccak-256 batches plus real secp256k1 ECDSA verdicts on both installed adapters.
It does not by itself prove hardware Ed25519 verification.
GPU output remains non-consensus evidence; the CPU reference is the acceptance authority.
